jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner, Generalist
jobs.description: HELP BUILD THE TEAMS SCALING CUTTING-EDGE CONSTRUCTION TECHNOLOGY At XYZ Reality we've created the world's first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our product, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to help construction teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes. As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, we're looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner to help build the business teams behind our next stage of growth, from HR, Finance and Legal to Marketing, Commercial and leadership roles. THE ROLE You'll own hiring across a broad range of business functions globally, partnering with leaders across HR, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Commercial, and supporting leadership hires as we grow. You'll work alongside our Talent Acquisition Partner - Technology as part of a small, high-impact TA team, reporting to our Head of Talent Acquisition. This isn't a role focused on processing applications. You'll proactively find and engage the strongest people in the market, many of whom aren't actively looking, and advise hiring managers on what great looks like, where to find it and how to secure it. No two weeks will look the same. One week you might be mapping the market for a senior Finance hire, the next closing a Marketing role in Europe or helping a leader shape a brand-new team. The role is based in our London office, a 5-minute walk from Angel station, on a hybrid basis. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Own end-to-end hiring for business roles globally (brief → offer → close), up to and including leadership positions Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring plans, shape role profiles and challenge requirements where needed Lead with direct sourcing, headhunting passive talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, networks, referrals and creative approaches Run discreet, high-touch searches for senior and leadership hires Manage hiring across multiple countries, navigating local market

jobs.description: Kualifikasi Wajib Pendidikan minimal S1, semua jurusan. Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang rekrutmen, interview, atau sales. Komunikasi lisan yang jelas dan persuasif, mampu menjelaskan skema tanpa menekan kandidat. Mampu menilai dengan scorecard secara objektif dan konsisten, bukan berdasarkan kesan. Sanggup menyelesaikan minimal 16 interview per hari kerja dengan kualitas penilaian terjaga. Familiar bekerja dengan Google Sheets. Nilai Tambah Latar belakang Psikologi atau HR. Pengalaman mass hiring tenaga lapangan (sales, kurir, gig worker). Latar belakang fintech, kredit, atau risk screening. Pernah melatih atau mengevaluasi tim sales. Terbiasa dengan sistem pelaporan harian berbasis target. Job Description Menjalankan interview terstruktur untuk kandidat SA dengan scorecard yang menilai dua area, yaitu kesiapan di lokasi kerja (readiness at the location) dan motivasi serta komitmen untuk join, minimal 16 interview per hari kerja. Menggali readiness di lokasi kerja dan motivasi serta komitmen join kandidat melalui interview Menjelaskan skema kompensasi dan target kinerja SA secara jujur dan mengkonfirmasi kesediaan kandidat. Mengonfirmasi kesiapan kandidat mulai bekerja sesuai tanggal onboarding, termasuk kelengkapan administrasi dan penyelesaian kewajiban di pekerjaan sebelumnya. Menilai kandidat secara objektif dengan scorecard, menandai red flag, dan mengisi scorecard di hari yang sama. Meneruskan kandidat yang lulus ke ASL untuk deep-dive interview. Memperbarui status kandidat kepada vendor dan ASL, serta memantau kandidat yang join di hari pertama dan retensi 1 bulan dan 3 bulan. Melaporkan setiap minggu alasan kandidat gagal dan batal join sebagai masukan evaluasi sourcing dan kriteria seleksi.

Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. What You Will Be Doing Lead ActAI's highest-priority technical searches across AI/ML, engineering leadership, backend, infrastructure, web and mobile. Coach technical recruiters on sourcing strategy, profile assessment, candidate engagement and closing. Review pipeline quality and recruiting data, identify where searches are failing and change strategy quickly. Develop repeatable recruiting practices that improve hiring quality and speed as ActAI scales. jobs.title: Stage: Afdeling HR
jobs.description: Over Nedlin Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen. De stageopdrachten Bij de afdeling HR hebben we twee interessante stageopdrachten openstaan. Beide opdrachten zijn gericht op het slimmer, efficiënter en minder foutgevoelig maken van onze HR-processen. Samen kijken we welke opdracht het beste aansluit bij jouw opleiding, interesses en kwaliteiten. Opdracht 1: Optimaliseren van HR- en verzuimprocessen Binnen HR vinden veel mutaties plaats in Medicum, onze verzuimmonitor, en AFAS. Een deel van deze mutaties heeft direct invloed op de loonstroken en salarisbetalingen. Jij brengt het huidige proces in kaart en onderzoekt hoe we dit slimmer kunnen inrichten. Het doel is om processen beter op elkaar aan te laten sluiten, handmatige handelingen te verminderen en de kans op fouten bij salarisbetalingen te verkleinen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren en in kaart brengen van de huidige processen en mutatiestromen; Het signaleren van knelpunten en foutgevoelige stappen; Het onderzoeken van mogelijkheden voor automatisering en procesverbetering; Het uitwerken van een praktisch advies voor een efficiëntere werkwijze. Opdracht 2: Uitzendkrachtenproces & managementinformatie Binnen Nedlin werken we samen met verschillende inhouse uitzendbureaus. Om inzicht te krijgen in de prestaties wordt managementinformatie momenteel grotendeels handmatig bijgehouden in een dashboard. jobs.description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. jobs.title: Human Resources Manager
jobs.description: The HR Manager will manage and improve the company’s overall HR operations. This role will help ensure that HR policies, systems, and practices are aligned with business goals, labor laws, and employee needs. The successful candidate will act as a trusted partner to management and employees. They will help build a positive, compliant, and productive workplace while supporting employee growth and organizational development. Duties and Responsibilities Lead the full cycle of HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, compensation and benefits, performance management, training, and employee engagement. Develop, update, and implement HR policies, procedures, and programs that support company goals and comply with Philippine labor laws and DOLE requirements. Manage end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition strategies to attract qualified candidates through job platforms, LinkedIn, referrals, and other sourcing channels. Improve employee experience by supporting engagement programs, workplace communication, employee feedback, and retention initiatives. Partner with department heads and managers to understand staffing needs, employee concerns, and organizational goals. Guide managers and employees on HR policies, workplace concerns, disciplinary actions, grievance handling, and conflict resolution. Ensure accurate and timely administration of compensation, benefits, government-mandated benefits, employee records, and HR documentation. Monitor HR metrics such as hiring timelines, turnover, attendance, employee engagement, and training needs to support better decision-making. Plan and implement training and development programs to improve employee skills, leadership capability, and work performance. Support performance management processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and employee development plans.
